login_flow: Instagram API with Facebook Login; do not mix Instagram Login permission names

oauth_settings.state_owner: native n8n OAuth credential flow; never invent state or client identifiers

required_human_prerequisite: Register or make available the company-owned Meta application and bind its client configuration in hosted n8n through secure credential settings. App secrets must never be sent in chat.
consent_link_generation: After a real client binding and registered redirect exist, obtain the authorization URL from native n8n OAuth; preserve its generated state. No placeholder consent link is supplied.
secure_token_handling: Native n8n encrypted credentials only; never tokens in Growth Queue, query logs or Git
Do not fetch page access tokens as saved Manager execution outputs; its existing logging is preserved
Discovery does not request access_token fields; secure page credential provisioning is a separate blocked step
HTTP200 or granted scopes alone do not prove that a post was published
remaining_production_steps_after_authori: Discover exact managed Page and linked Instagram identity from real complete API responses
Verify token validity/app identity/grants/page task/target Page credential/Instagram publishing limit using live read-only evidence
Implement and bind official transport against those verified encrypted credentials; no stub credential is deployed
Retain original scheduling and revision-bound human approval; future content only, immutable cross-provider reservations and uncertain-delivery holds
Activate eligible platforms independently and retain actual platform post IDs/readback; never test with public demo posts
